description: This file defines the 'BuzzLikeOnShare' entity class for a Human Resource Management System, representing a 'like' action on a shared post in a social interaction module. It includes ORM mapping annotations, properties for ID, share reference, employee reference, and timestamp, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShare
classes.description: Entity class representing a 'like' on a shared post in the Buzz module, with ORM mappings, properties, and methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the like record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the like record.

methods.name: setShare
methods.description: Associates a BuzzShare entity with this like.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity who liked the share.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity who liked the share.

methods.name: getLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the like was made, in UTC.

methods.name: setLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of when the like was made to the current time in UTC.
